spring_and_tangent_replay.proof_boundary: Every frozen energy vector was authenticated to a whole source state that was available no later than spring entry; every internal coordinate/energy was found in the prior paid trace and endpoint energies were independently recomputed. Every spring tangent was independently recomputed at every iteration. Non-spring calls retain ordered input/output digests and are supported by the separately sealed reachable-call audit, not claimed as numerical replay.
spring_and_tangent_replay.source_index_convention: zero-based archive row for public/recovery states; zero-based paid-trace start row for a contiguous complete band
